name: palisade
description: The Palisade (palisade, palisade_2), rebuilt from scratch for ROADMAP 52.3 (tools/blueprints/briefs/palisade.md, REBUILD.md). MC_BUILDER = the minecraft-builder skill's folder. Until the critic says SHIP, 'build' writes candidates; 'check' asserts the briefs' pins on the kit's three candidates.

scripts.build: node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py palisade palisade --candidate --nbt out/palisade.nbt && LEVEL=2 node "$MC_BUILDER/scripts/run-build.mjs" recipe.mjs --out-dir out --data-version 3955 && python3 ../../rebuild.py palisade palisade_2 --candidate --nbt out/palisade-2.nbt
